semantics.nominal_design_porosity: designer-selected target used as the inverse-design coordinate
semantics.delta: deterministic compaction-control tolerance evaluated at nominal minus, centre, and nominal plus delta
semantics.eps_phi: residual within-batch achieved-porosity scatter; it is not an additional delta term

support_threshold_source: STATE_SUPPORT_CONTRACT.json / frozen OCSVM+KDE threshold; copied here for post-run analyses
limitation: Training data contain measured hardened porosity, not target-versus-achieved pairs; baseline 1.0 percentage point remains an engineering prior unless replicate evidence clearly supports another value.
